name: Budgets
description: These APIs manage budget configurations for this account. Budgets enable you to monitor usage across your account. You can set up budgets to either track account-wide spending, or apply filters to track the spending of specific teams, projects, or workspaces.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Create a new budget configuration for an account. For full details, see https://docs.databricks.com/en/admin/account-settings/budgets.html.

required_fields.description: Properties of the new budget configuration.

required_request_body_fields.name: budget
required_request_body_fields.description: Properties of the new budget configuration.

all_fields.name: budget
all_fields.description: Properties of the new budget configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a budget configuration for an account. Both account and budget configuration are specified by ID. This cannot be undone.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Gets a budget configuration for an account. Both account and budget configuration are specified by ID.

methods.name: GetBudgetSpendStatus
methods.description:
Get the calling user's live spend against the blocking thresholds of a single Unity Gateway
budget. Any account user can call this for their own spend. Spend is reported in USD at list
price and is near-real-time, so it may differ slightly from billing data. Returns NOT_FOUND if
the budget doesn't exist or has no blocking thresholds.
methods.summary: Get the calling user's spend status for a budget.
methods.cli_launch_stage_banner: This command is in Beta and may change without notice.

required_fields.name: name
required_fields.description:
The resource name of the budget spend status to read, of the form
`accounts/{account_id}/budget-spend-statuses/{budget_id}`. A `budget_id` that isn't a valid
UUID fails with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

required_in_url_fields.name: name
required_in_url_fields.description:
The resource name of the budget spend status to read, of the form
`accounts/{account_id}/budget-spend-statuses/{budget_id}`. A `budget_id` that isn't a valid
UUID fails with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description:
The resource name of the budget spend status to read, of the form
`accounts/{account_id}/budget-spend-statuses/{budget_id}`. A `budget_id` that isn't a valid
UUID fails with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

required_positional_arguments.name: name
required_positional_arguments.description:

methods.name: ListBudgetSpendStatuses
methods.description:
List the calling user's live spend against the blocking thresholds across the account's Unity
Gateway budgets. Any account user can call this for their own spend. Spend is reported in USD
at list price and is near-real-time, so it may differ slightly from billing data. By default,
returns every budget in the account that has a blocking threshold. Use `filter` to narrow
results by workspace.
methods.summary: List the calling user's budget spend statuses.
methods.cli_launch_stage_banner: This command is in Beta and may change without notice.

required_fields.name: parent
required_fields.description: The parent account whose budget spend statuses to list, of the form `accounts/{account_id}`.

required_in_url_fields.name: parent
required_in_url_fields.description: The parent account whose budget spend statuses to list, of the form `accounts/{account_id}`.

all_fields.name: filter
all_fields.description:
A filter expression that narrows the returned budgets by workspace. Only `workspace_id` is
supported, in lower case with numeric workspace IDs, for example `workspace_id = 123` or
`workspace_id IN (123, 456)`. Matches budgets that apply to any of the listed workspaces,
including budgets that apply to all workspaces. Any other expression, such as an empty `IN ()`
list, fails with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE. If empty, returns every budget in the account that has
a blocking threshold.

all_fields.name: page_size
all_fields.description:
The maximum number of spend statuses to return per page. If unspecified or 0, at most 100 are
returned. The maximum value is 100; values above 100 are coerced to 100. Negative values fail
with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE. The server may return fewer results than requested, including
zero, even when more pages remain; page until `next_page_token` is absent.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description:
A page token from a previous `ListBudgetSpendStatuses` response, used to fetch the next page.
Requests the first page if absent. All other request parameters except `page_size` must match
the request that returned the token; otherwise the request fails with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

all_fields.name: parent
all_fields.description: The parent account whose budget spend statuses to list, of the form `accounts/{account_id}`.

required_positional_arguments.name: parent
required_positional_arguments.description: The parent account whose budget spend statuses to list, of the form `accounts/{account_id}`.
